summary: Spokane County site: 1942 tower replaced 1954 and moved to Lookout Point (move date disputed); the summit now has an FAA dome and is marked off limits.

facts.design: 40-foot wooden tower with 8x8 cab and cabin (1942), replaced in 1954 by a 40-foot wooden DNR tower with 14x14 cab
facts.status_note: The 1954 tower was moved off the summit to Lookout Point; the summit now has an FAA dome

access.note: Park maps mark the summit off limits, per Will Hite's guide; the summit holds an FAA dome

events.note: 40-foot wooden tower with 8x8 cab and a cabin at the base
Short-wave radio installed, linking the lookout to Stevens, Pend Oreille and Spokane county lookouts
Smoke reported on July 15; found to be a resident burning grass and yard trimmings seven miles away
Replaced by a 40-foot wooden DNR tower with 14x14 cab, built by Wayne Rieper and Paul Anderson
Air Force acquired 20 acres and built a radar station on the peak; the new tower had to be removed
Moved to Lookout Point north of Spokane. Dates disagree: register 1955, NHLR 1956, Will Hite 1976
At Lookout Point: NHLR says staffed until 1995; Will Hite says staffed 1976 to 1992 and reopened for the 1994 fire season

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The gone status applies to the Mica Peak summit. The 1954 tower was moved to Lookout Point, where it stands today; the move year is disputed (1955 Former Fire Lookout Sites Register, 1956 NHLR, 1976 Will Hite).

notes_for_editor: Record checked: coordinates match FFLOS (47.57361, -117.08153), elevation 1,586 m matches FFLOS 5,205 ft. The 'gone' status fits the summit; the tower itself stands at Lookout Point, behind a gated community. Move date for Lookout Point is disputed three ways (1955, 1956, 1976). Lookout Point staffing end date disputed (1995 vs 1992). The Will Hite guide's quote on the summit includes a garbled character; the story quotes only clean text. Do not encourage summit visits: the summit is marked off limits on park maps and holds an FAA dome. Lookout Point is private (gated community); no public access.
